A line-break-only emphasis nested inside an otherwise empty strong wrapper still separates the words on either side

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p><strong>Alpha</strong><strong><em><br></em></strong>Beta</p>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
